instruction: Thorough authorized security audit of the owner's OWN app (UniGoat: static HTML/JS/Capacitor + Supabase Postgres backend). Go DEEP on: (1) Supabase RLS/authorization gaps and SECURITY DEFINER function abuse in supabase/migrations and supabase/functions (edge functions), (2) exposed secrets/service_role keys/tokens in www/ client code, (3) auth bypass and privilege escalation (admin flags is_admin, verification bypass), (4) IDOR/broken access control in coupon redemption (public.self_redeem), admin.html, partner submissions, (5) XSS via innerHTML with user data across ALL html files, (6) insecure direct object references and missing ownership checks. Report every real, exploitable finding with exact file:line and a concrete exploit scenario.
